[[File:Matt Manning BoardMatt 2022-02-27 still.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Matt Manning. Still: BoardMatt.]]
'''Matt Manning''' (GEMP handle '''Mantron''')<ref name="org2022">Email from Stephen Sanders to Retro League participants, 2026 (player name / GEMP handle / forum name list for 2022).</ref> (also known as Matthew Manning) finished '''#8''' at the [[2026 Retro U.S. Nationals]].<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-07-retro-u-s-nationals-prem-to-dsii-new-brunswick-new-jersey-aug-1-2026/ 2026 Retro U.S. Nationals] (preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012175621/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-07-retro-u-s-nationals-prem-to-dsii-new-brunswick-new-jersey-aug-1-2026.html Internet Archive]), starwarsccg.org</ref> He is the creator of the YouTube channel [[BoardMatt]].<ref name="ch-bm">[https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCASbMFC84yQRUECyFtSaNXw BoardMatt], YouTube channel (uploads list, 15 October 2026).</ref> He also played the [[2022 Retro League|2022]] and [[2023 Retro League|2023]] [[Retro League]].
